# Tianyou (Theo) Lai

> MS student in Artificial Intelligence Systems Management at Carnegie Mellon University.
> Research in reliable learning, model evaluation, federated learning, unlearning, and applied machine learning.

- Name: Tianyou (Theo) Lai
- Site: https://laitty.github.io/
